verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents training its agent on 'business context, brand guidelines, help docs and standard operating procedures' (docs-25) and mentions 'grounding' as a guardrail check (docs-35), but there is no evidence that end-user-facing answers cite or display the specific article/source used to generate a response.
